parameters.name: IncludeTags
parameters.description:
Whether to query tag information. Values:  

- Enabled: Query.  
- Disabled (default): Do not query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the template list.  
Start value: 1.  
Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page in a paginated query.  
Value range: 1~50.  
Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.  
For more information about resource groups, see [What is a Resource Group](~~94475~~).

parameters.name: ShareType
parameters.description:
The sharing type of the template.  

Values:  
- Private (default): The template is owned by the user.  
- Shared: The template is shared by other users.  
- Official: The template is officially shared.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: Tags. A maximum of 20 tags are supported.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description:
The name of the template. This parameter is effective only when ShareType is Private.  
The length must not exceed 255 characters and must start with a digit or a letter. It can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros list-templates --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --template-name MyTemplate --share-type Private --tag Value=deploy Key=usage --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000 --include-tags Enabled --filters '[{"Values":["ROS"],"Name":"Categories"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ros ListTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeTags Enabled --Tag.1.Key usage --Filters.1.Name Categories --PageSize 10 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000' --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value deploy --Filters.1.Values.1 ROS --TemplateName MyTemplate --ShareType Private
